name: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct
definition: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct is an open-weight Qwen3-VL model by Qwen / Alibaba focused on documents, visual understanding, multimodal agents and tool-oriented workflows.

license.name: Apache 2.0
license.commercial_use: Review exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: High-memory workstation or GPU server; image/video workloads add encoder and context overhead.

deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
